name: Anthropic (Claude API)

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.label: Workspace ID (only if the key is not scoped to one workspace)

auth.keyHelp: Click Create key, choose a personal key and pick a single workspace so no workspace header is needed; the key is shown only once.

read.label: Count tokens in a message before sending

write.label: Send a message to Claude (billed per token)

tested: mock; real service refused a fake key
notes: AUTH CHANGED: the Authentication page now says the API key is sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' and that 'x-api-key' is a legacy fallback that is still supported; the API overview table repeats this (Authorization required, x-api-key optional legacy). This manifest uses x-api-key with no prefix because it is the documented fallback and is simplest to store; switch to header Authorization / prefix 'Bearer ' to follow the current recommendation. VERSION: the Versions page says every request must send anthropic-version and gives 2026-10-21 as the latest (recommended); the Authentication page's own example still shows anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 and the cURL snippet there still uses x-api-key. Which older versions are still accepted was not confirmed; 2026-10-21 is pinned here, with a migration guide linked from the Versions page (not read). WORKSPACE: a key not scoped to a workspace MUST also send anthropic-workspace-id on every request or the API returns 400; keys scoped to one workspace omit it. Key types: personal, service account, and legacy workspace key; keys start with sk-ant-; shown only once; expiration chosen at creation (3 hours to Never; a 401 after expiry). TEST: GET /v1/models only lists models; the Models page does not state cost, and the call changes nothing. It does not name the account, so who is null. count_tokens: listed in the API overview as POST /v1/messages/count_tokens; its body fields and 'free' status were NOT read, so they are an expectation (the overview describes it as a way to manage costs). The Messages page excerpt showed model, max_tokens and messages as the required body fields. GET /v1/files appears in the API overview; query params were not read. Model ids in docs examples include claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-4-6. MCP: platform.claude.com/docs/llms.txt has an 'MCP server' section: connect an MCP client to https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp (Streamable HTTP) to search and read the Claude API docs; a server card is at https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp/server-card. Auth is not mentioned on that page (assumed none, unconfirmed). It is a documentation server hosted by Anthropic, not an MCP server that calls the API for the user. No separate Anthropic-run API-control MCP server was found.
